name: Ayukawa Satomi
source: The protagonist's mother. She is very strict with the protagonist to the point that he hates her. Satomi does not allow the protagonist the follow his own path as she and her husband decided that he will be the successor to his father's company. She does not allow him to have any kind of joy as she wants him to only focus on his grades.
